channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: ERA limits ship maintenance at Malta Freeport to emergencies
item.description: ERA accepts Birżebbuġa local council request to restrict ship maintenance at the Malta Freeport to emergency situations, as part of updated environmental permit conditions

item.title: Paul Cassar’s new solo exhibition: A journey into colour, life, memory and transcendence
item.description: Paul Cassar’s vivid palette will once again be showcased in his new exhibition: 60. The exhibition commemorates the artist’s sixtieth birthday while also being a uniquely personal tribute to the memory of a loved one

item.title: BRND WGN announces strategic investment and partnership with global agency nmbl
item.description: nmbl has acquired a strategic stake in WGN Ventures, BRND WGN’s investment and growth vehicle - an investment designed to accelerate international expansion, strengthen operational scale, and unlock new global opportunities

item.title: Denmark and the people of Greenland should decide island’s fate, Abela says
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela urges prudence, restraint and continued support for peace and de-escalation efforts during an informal meeting of the European Council in Brussels

item.title: Europe’s competitiveness at a crossroads: Power, principles, and pragmatism
item.description: If Europe fails to adapt, it risks becoming a rule-maker without rule-takers. But if it succeeds, it may yet prove that competitiveness and values are not mutually exclusive, just harder to sustain in a changing world

item.title: Parents and persons with disabilities should not be ignored | Marthese Mugliette
item.description: Parents must be encouraged to speak up when issues arise; otherwise, nothing will change. Authorities must listen, understand, and act

item.title: Mizzi Estates resubmits plans to rebuild hotel in Natura 2000 site in Mellieħa
item.description: Mizzi Estates have once again submitted a planning application to rebuild a long-derelict hotel within a Natura 2000 site in Mellieħa

item.title: Former Birgu oil depot to be transformed into 1,500sq.m public garden
item.description: Long-neglected land, formerly an oil depot in Birgu transformed into 1,500sq.m public garden designed to serve as a green, climate-sensitive community space along the Kalkara Creek promenade

item.title: Parliament’s foreign affairs committee condemns repression and killings in Iran
item.description: Committee expresses solidarity with Iranian people and warns of risk of escalating regional tensions.

item.title: President meets young girl who donated her hair to help sick children
item.description: The nine-year-old’s altruistic gesture, carried out while on holiday in Malta, inspired a children’s book whose proceeds will support the Malta Community Chest Fund’s work with patients who lose their hair due to medical conditions
